queries.site:
SELECT id FROM characters WHERE alive AND is_npc
         AND (jail_until IS NULL OR jail_until < now())
         AND (hosp_until IS NULL OR hosp_until < now()) LIMIT 24

         AND (jail_until IS NULL OR jail_until < now())

queries.eligibleSql:
SELECT * FROM characters WHERE alive AND is_npc
         AND (jail_until IS NULL OR jail_until < now())
         AND (hosp_until IS NULL OR hosp_until < now())
queries.transformedSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(rc1_limited) FROM (SELECT id FROM characters WHERE alive AND is_npc
         AND (jail_until IS NULL OR jail_until < now())
         AND (hosp_until IS NULL OR hosp_until < now()) LIMIT 24) rc1_limited), '[]'::json) AS limited_rows,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(rc1_eligible)::text) FROM (SELECT * FROM characters WHERE alive AND is_npc
         AND (jail_until IS NULL OR jail_until < now())
         AND (hosp_until IS NULL OR hosp_until < now())) rc1_eligible), '[]'::json) AS eligible_rows

queries.site:
SELECT a.account_id, ${sel}, c.name, c.respect
       FROM account_persistent a
       JOIN characters c ON c.account_id = a.account_id AND c.alive
       JOIN accounts ac ON ac.id = a.account_id
      WHERE NOT a.agent_flag AND NOT a.npc_flag AND ac.status <> 'banned'
